description: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike, backed entirely by remote sources through Gelato. No local media is assumed. Own auth/session runtime and directly rendered screens, not a reskin of native jellyfin-web components.
name: Jellio
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike.

versions.changelog:
## [1.10.1] - 2026-09-21

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Use console.warn for the native Media Segments diagnostic

## [1.10.0] - 2026-09-21

### 🚀 Features

- Sweep the whole library for intro/credits, auto-trigger on import

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Harden and log the native Media Segments read

## [1.9.0] - 2026-09-21

### 🚀 Features

- Build our own cross-episode intro/credits analyzer

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fall back to embedded chapter names for Skip Intro/Credits
- Stop naming Jellyfin's own User type directly

## [1.8.0] - 2026-09-20

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

## [1.7.0] - 2026-09-20

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

## [1.5.2] - 2026-09-14

### ⚡ Performance

- Stop rebuilding catalog/genre rows on every playback session end

## [1.5.1] - 2026-09-14

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Stop forcing blur before opening the profile switcher

## [1.5.0] - 2026-09-13

### 🚀 Features

- Auto-select a saved subtitle language preference on playback start
- Detect MULTi/Dual Audio releases with no other language signal

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Show the language filter row even with a single language

## [1.4.1] - 2026-09-12

- Replace SortBy=Random with CommunityRating + client shuffle

## [1.3.6] - 2026-09-12

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

## [1.3.4] - 2026-09-12

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

## [1.3.3] - 2026-09-11

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Log the real MediaError on a failed video playback attempt

### ⚡ Performance

- Prefetch Series cards too, not just Movie/Episode

## [1.3.2] - 2026-09-10

### ⚡ Performance

- Prefetch Gelato streams on card hover/focus
- Split search into independent Movies/Series requests

### 💼 Other

- Gelato prefetch wiring and split search

## [1.3.1] - 2026-09-05

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Don't merge episodes across a season boundary into one binge group

## [1.3.0] - 2026-09-05

### 🚀 Features

- Let an admin delete a feed entry, relock a badge, and reset a user's progress

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Don't credit a real watch from 'ended' before playback ever started

## [1.2.1] - 2026-09-04

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Retry a failed subtitle load instead of giving up after one attempt

## [1.2.0] - 2026-09-04

### 🚀 Features

- Split search results into Movies and Series sections

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Let the language filter treat original-audio-only as its own choice

## [1.1.0] - 2026-09-04

### 🚀 Features

- Tag original-audio-only sources, add a language filter to Change Stream

## [1.0.5] - 2026-09-04

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Pin subtitle cues to a fixed real percentage, not auto line stacking

### 📚 Documentation

- Add a README

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Stop the final playback-stopped report from undoing a real watch

- Credit a real watch as soon as Up Next appears, not only on ended
- Use the real observed duration for Continue Watching too, not just achievements
- Mark a real watch played in native Jellyfin too, not just this plugin's own state

## [1.0.2] - 2026-09-03

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- *(release)* Stop git-cliff from splitting commit bodies into duplicate changelog entries
- Credit a real watch on natural playback end, not just the 90% ratio

## [1.0.1] - 2026-09-03

- Credit achievements off the real stream duration, not metadata
